meta.title: The Thinking — Dr Robert Freudenthal
meta.description: Twenty years studying how psychiatric evidence is made, accepted and abandoned — and four of sixteen publications.

sections.label: The Thinking
sections.quote: An expert gives an opinion, then has to hold it <t>when the other side attacks its basis.</t>
body: He has studied that problem as a discipline. An intercalated BSc in the History of Medicine at the Wellcome Trust Centre. An MSc thesis on insulin coma therapy. A paper in History of Psychiatry on how a treatment once called a landmark in psychiatric progress rose and fell.
And, separately, published work on how far the participants in psychiatric clinical trials resemble the patients those trials are meant to serve.
